rationale: The plan matches the reference on the essential point: tximport at gene level with the named tx2gene.csv, countsFromAbundance='no', the average-transcript-length offset carried into the DESeqDataSet, fractional NumReads left unrounded, and a report of transcripts unmatched between the map and quant.sf. The two-group Wald model with Control as explicit reference, median-of-ratios inside DESeq2, a minimal 10-counts-in-6-samples filter, BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, and apeglm shrinkage are all stated precisely, with blind-VST PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes and an explicit outlier/flag policy preceding the test. Enrichment was not requested but is executed correctly (full Wald-stat ranking, tie rule, 15-500 window, per-collection BH, versions pinned). The only gap is that the annotation version of the transcript-to-gene map is never named, which the reference requires and which weakens the import and report sections slightly.
